---
title: "OrPen SC PDK"
description: "Public superconducting quantum and RF PDK documentation."
---

`orpen-sc-pdk` provides public superconducting quantum/RF layout cells, CPW
cross-sections, process layers, materials and semantic source geometry for
GDSFactory. Install the package in your own project; keep private chip designs,
parameters and run evidence in that project.

## Component layouts

![Default CPW resonator: actual DRAW and ETCH.](_static/images/components/resonator.svg){#fig-overview-resonator width=35%}

{{< askr-image-view target="fig-overview-resonator" label="Image: resonator" >}}

![Default interdigital capacitor: actual DRAW and ETCH.](_static/images/components/interdigital_capacitor.svg){#fig-overview-idc width=65%}

{{< askr-image-view target="fig-overview-idc" label="Image: interdigital capacitor" >}}

Open [Cells](public-pdk-examples/index.md#components-layout) for more component
views, or the [Test Components Set](public-pdk-examples/test-components.md) for
source-derived pad, strip, CPW, flip-chip and airbridge layouts. These are
image previews of current default factories: deep-teal DRAW and soft light-teal ETCH,
with auxiliary layers omitted. They are not a native GDS or simulation viewer.

Build reusable cells with GDSFactory and compose layouts using OrPen's CPW
cross-sections, layers and materials. The base M1 film defaults to 100 nm;
airbridge and bump levels retain their separately declared dimensions.
Examples are not measured process specifications.

Simulation is optional: version-bound notebooks pass layouts and semantic
intent to SCGSim for native geometry, meshes, solver handoff and reporting.

## Choose a task

- [Get Started](getting-started.md): install, activate OrPen and build a cell.
- [Cells](public-pdk-examples/index.md): choose factories, source test-layout
  families, tags or the inline component layout gallery.
- [Process](materials-and-technology.md): layers, stack, materials, interface
  presets and the source/runtime ownership boundary.
- [Simulation](notebooks.qmd): choose a version-bound public SCGSim example;
  distinguish revised source candidates from retained execution evidence.
- [API](reference/index.qmd): package, cell and material interfaces.

Source availability is not native mesh/contact/solver proof. The public source
test layouts and newer runtime examples retain their stated limitations.
